individuals.title: Snapshot API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Snapshot API allows users to retrieve entire Wikimedia projects as a database dump file.

individuals.title: On-demand API
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise On-demand API allows users to retrieve single articles from any supported Wikimedia project at anytime.

individuals.title: Realtime API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Realtime API allows users to stream updates in real-time from any supported Wikimedia project.

individuals.title: Enterprise APIs
individuals.quote: Three APIs; same data with different retrieval methods:

individuals.title: Realtime streaming
individuals.quote: Streaming: Receive streaming (firehose) updates of every change as they occur in real-time

individuals.title: Realtime batch
individuals.quote: Batch: Download compressed files of all articles that were changed, generated hourly

individuals.title: Event filtering
individuals.quote: Filtering of events by Project or Revision Namespace

individuals.title: Structured Contents (beta)
individuals.quote: Downloading Structured Contents (beta) datasets hosted on third-party platforms.

individuals.title: Article response payload
individuals.quote: All of our APIs return the same structured JSON (or ND-JSON) response format making it easy to augment one API with another.

individuals.title: Snapshot dump file
individuals.quote: Download a compressed file containing everything in any supported project, in any language

individuals.title: Free account thresholds
individuals.quote: Persistent need for access above the Enterprise API requests/second, or datasets/month, free thresholds

individuals.title: Wikimedia Dumps
individuals.quote: For high-volume reusers that currently rely on the Wikimedia Dumps to access our information

individuals.title: EventStream
individuals.quote: using EventStream APIs to access such changes

individuals.title: RESTBase
individuals.quote: depend on services like RESTBase to pull HTML from page titles and current revisions to update their products

individuals.title: Build services for high-volume commercial reusers
individuals.quote: The goal of the service is to build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content.

individuals.title: Improve readers' experience beyond Wikimedia's own websites
individuals.quote: improve the user experience of Wikimedia's readers beyond our own websites

individuals.title: Increase the reach and discoverability of the content
individuals.quote: increase the reach and discoverability of the content

individuals.title: Improve awareness and ease of attribution and verifiability
individuals.quote: improve awareness and ease of attribution and verifiability by the organizations that reuse Wikimedia project data the most

individuals.title: Program goal: Content
individuals.quote: **Content**: Make more of our movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats, freely available for all researchers and re-users.

individuals.title: Program goal: Resource-load
individuals.quote: **Resource-load**: Reduce the need for high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers, which currently target our production servers.

individuals.title: Program goal: Fundraising
individuals.quote: **Fundraising**: Provide a clearer and more consistent way for the largest re-users to reinvest derived benefits back to the movement

individuals.title: Democratize the data for organizations without the largest users' resources
individuals.quote: there is a responsibility to democratize our data for organizations that do not possess the resources of these largest users

individuals.title: Movement Strategy recommendations
individuals.quote: In the Movement Strategy recommendations to *increase the sustainability of our movement* and *improve user experience*

individuals.title: Large companies rely on Wikimedia content without reinvesting
individuals.quote: It is well known that a few massive companies use our projects' data.

individuals.title: High barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data
individuals.quote: There is a very high barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data, outside of the common use cases of reading or editing.

individuals.title: High-intensity scraping of production servers
individuals.quote: high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers, which currently target our production servers

individuals.title: Access for all
individuals.quote: in accordance with the project's principle of *access for all*

individuals.title: Non-exclusivity
individuals.quote: In accordance with the Wikimedia Enterprise operating principles regarding non-exclusivity, any newly developed software feature or dataset must be made available to all.

individuals.title: Wikimedia projects remain libre
individuals.quote: Wikimedia projects are, have always been, and will always remain *libre*.

individuals.title: Wikimedia projects remain gratis
individuals.quote: Equally, Wikimedia projects are, have always been, and will always remain *gratis*.

individuals.title: All Enterprise revenue supports the Wikimedia mission
individuals.quote: All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission

individuals.title: Avoid revenue dependencies and undue external influence
individuals.quote: taking care to avoid revenue dependencies or other undue external influence in product design and development

individuals.title: Self-funding service
individuals.quote: through self-funding services

individuals.title: Abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content
individuals.quote: All users of Wikimedia Enterprise services must abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content. They are inherent and cannot be waived.

individuals.title: Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy
individuals.quote: as described on the *Wikimedia Foundation Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy*

individuals.title: Human Rights Policy
individuals.quote: in accordance with the Human Rights Policy and Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy

individuals.title: User-Agent Policy
individuals.quote: the User-Agent Policy

individuals.title: Decision making rests with the Wikimedia Foundation
individuals.quote: Given the nature of the service, primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation.

individuals.title: Community editing tools are out of scope
individuals.quote: This includes the majority of community editing tools, which will be out of scope for this service.

individuals.title: Faster, more comprehensive, reliable and secure data services
individuals.quote: providing data services at a large scale, so that they are faster and more comprehensive, reliable, and secure

individuals.title: Frequency: regular current snapshots
individuals.quote: **Frequency**: Regular current snapshots of Wikimedia projects

individuals.title: Reliability: dependable, accessible infrastructure
individuals.quote: **Reliability**: Dependable, accessible infrastructure

individuals.title: Quality: a best last revision
individuals.quote: **Quality**: a “best last revision”

individuals.title: Filter the changes received
individuals.quote: a service that will allow them to filter the changes they receive to limit their processing

individuals.title: Stable HTTP connections with no data loss
individuals.quote: guarantee stable HTTP connections to ensure no data loss

individuals.title: A more useful schema to limit API calls per event
individuals.quote: supply a more useful schema to limit the number of API calls they need to make per event

individuals.title: Reliable retrieval of article data in structures other than HTML
individuals.quote: High-volume reusers have requested a reliable means to gather this data, as well as structures other than HTML

individuals.title: Exceptional access criteria
individuals.quote: **Exceptional access criteria**

individuals.title: Criterion 1: Who
individuals.quote: **1. Who** (individual or organisation) is requesting exceptional access?

individuals.title: Criterion 2: What
individuals.quote: **2. What** is the request for?

individuals.title: Criterion 3: Need
individuals.quote: **3. Need**. Can the intended use-case be fulfilled via any of the existing free access methods?

individuals.title: Criterion 4: Obligation
individuals.quote: **4. Obligation.** Would the intended use case require custom development to support or maintain?

individuals.title: Criterion 5: Mission alignment
individuals.quote: **5. Mission alignment**. Is the intended use case aligned with any of the needs identified in the Movement Strategy Recommendations?

individuals.title: Criterion 6: Values alignment
individuals.quote: **6. Values alignment**. Do the requester’s professional practices or business model align with Wikimedia’s values?
